title: Earnings Statement Glossary: Trip Pay and Pro Points on a Completed Trip
content:
**Trip pay.** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, trip pay posts only to an earnings account that is awaiting payout setup, active or on payout hold, once per completed trip, at drop-off. Trip pay is the time-and-distance pay of the ride option the trip was requested under plus the trip's add-ons. Driver pay does not depend on the rider's fare, Pass discount or Pass credits, and airport access fees are never driver pay.

**Time-and-distance pay** is, from the driver rate card for the trip's ride option, the base plus the per-mile rate multiplied by the trip's actual miles plus the per-minute rate multiplied by the trip's actual minutes; that sum is multiplied by the busy-time multiplier recorded at the request and by the driver's share of that multiplier (the busy-time share in the driver pay schedule). Time-and-distance pay is the larger of that figure and the option's minimum trip pay, so it is never below the minimum.

**Add-ons** are the total of:
1. the option's flat trip extra;
2. wait pay: the option's driver wait rate multiplied by the billable wait minutes the rider was charged for the trip's wait time;
3. toll pay: the toll reimbursement share of the tolls the rider was charged on the trip;
4. long pickup pay: when the original pickup estimate exceeds the long pickup threshold, the long pickup rate multiplied by the estimated pickup minutes above the threshold;
5. reservation pay: the driver's reservation fee share of the trip's reservation fee, when one was charged and not refunded.

Trip pay is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, after the add-ons are totalled with time-and-distance pay. All rates and thresholds named here are those of the driver pay schedules of the product.

**Pro points.** Each completed trip also earns Pro points for the quarter of its drop-off: the peak-trip points when the request fell in a peak period, otherwise the premium-trip points for a premium ride option, otherwise the standard-trip points. Peak and premium points are never added together.

## Status of the account and trip pay

| Earnings account status | Trip pay posts? |
|---|---|
| Awaiting payout setup | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| On payout hold | Yes |
| Closed | No |

## Hypothetical worked figures

The rates below are read from the driver pay schedules; the trips are invented for illustration.

- **Wayfare Comfort, 8.0 actual miles, 20 actual minutes, busy-time multiplier 1.0, 3 billable wait minutes charged, a toll of 2.50 charged, original pickup estimate 13 minutes, no reservation fee.** Time-and-distance: 1.55 plus 7.36 (0.92 for each of 8.0 miles) plus 4.40 (0.22 for each of 20 minutes) is 13.31, above the 5.25 minimum. Add-ons: trip extra 0.00, wait 1.08 (0.36 for each of 3 minutes), toll 2.50 at 100%, long pickup 0.72 (0.24 for each of the 3 minutes above 10). Trip pay: 17.61.
- **Wayfare Standard, 1.2 actual miles, 4 actual minutes, busy-time multiplier 1.5, no add-ons.** 1.00 plus 0.792 plus 0.64 is 2.432; multiplied by 1.5 and by the 100% share it is 3.648, below the 3.75 minimum, so time-and-distance pay is 3.75 and trip pay is 3.75.

## Points: hypothetical cases

| Trip | Points basis |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Black SUV trip requested in a peak period | Peak-trip points only |
| Wayfare Black trip requested outside peak periods | Premium-trip points |
| Wayfare XL trip requested outside peak periods | Standard-trip points |
